headline: Ye's Chicago Night 2 Guests Revealed: Akademiks Drops Exclusive List
body: DJ Akademiks shared Instagram post detailing every guest Ye brought out for Night 2 of Chicago events. The post, published September 5, 2026, shows 14 artists including Future, Drake, and Travis Scott. The post has garnered 6,706 likes and 411 comments. Akademiks' post uses emojis like 🤯🐐 to emphasize the surprise lineup. This update comes as Ye's Chicago residency continues to generate buzz in hip-hop circles.
